strengths: Identifies a concrete and practically important failure mode (high-staleness off-policy RLVR) with specific empirical evidence of baseline crashes and poor performance, lending credibility to the motivation
Proposes an adaptive mechanism (AC-MIS-PO) with clear algorithmic intuition—quantile-based bound discovery and EMA smoothing—that addresses a genuine limitation of fixed-hyperparameter approaches
Reports strong quantitative gains (32.57% vs 6.57%–18.67% for all baselines) on standard math benchmarks, with a training stability narrative that is falsifiable
weaknesses: Evaluation is confined to a single staleness level (s=256); it is unclear whether AC-MIS-PO remains superior at lower staleness regimes or whether the acceptance schedule (40%→20%) needs re-tuning per setting

The acceptance schedule design (start at 40%, decay to 20%) appears heuristic; no ablation is presented on schedule shape, decay rate, or EMA coefficient, making it hard to assess how sensitive performance is to these choices

The method is incremental over MIS-PO: the core idea (importance-ratio masking) is unchanged, and the contribution is essentially an adaptive hyperparameter controller. The introduction does not situate this relative to general adaptive clipping or curriculum approaches in RL
Generalization beyond mathematical reasoning is not discussed; RLVR with code or other verifiable domains may have different staleness dynamics, limiting the scope of the claimed contribution

ai_detection.reasoning: The introduction follows a near-canonical AI-generated structure: one paragraph per narrative beat (background, problem, prior work, proposed solution, contributions), terminated by an exact three-bullet contributions list with leading bullet symbols and quantitative payoffs formatted identically. Prose transitions are uniformly formulaic ('However, these methods...', 'We propose...', 'Our contributions are as follows:') with no hedging, authorial voice, or discursive asides characteristic of human academic writing. The specificity of numbers (32.57%, step 94 crash) does not offset the templated macro-structure.
